mode: API integration tests against real application routes and SQLite, with synthetic external provider responses and photograph. Browser interaction has not been executed.

rows.title: Discover species, hotspots and recent sightings
rows.actual: 200 OK; Indian Roller joins to Demo Wetland and its recent report. Source IDs retained; API key absent.

rows.title: Upload a valid photograph and protect its metadata
rows.actual: 201 Created; camera metadata extracted; private GPS detected; served JPEG has no embedded EXIF; one media record.

rows.title: Save a private observation to the journal
rows.actual: 201 Created; owner journal contains one observation; photo and bird totals are 1; other account feed excludes it.

rows.title: Share an observation while withholding exact coordinates
rows.actual: 200 OK; other account can read the public post and photo; hotspot name shown; privateLocation absent.

rows.title: Bookmark a catalogue species without duplicate records
rows.actual: 200 OK; two save requests produce one saved reference; later read retains it; viewer has no bookmark.

rows.title: Reject a corrupt photograph and allow a valid replacement
rows.error: Cannot decode this photograph. Use a valid single-frame JPEG/PNG of at most 40 megapixels.
rows.actual: 422 Unprocessable Entity; corrupt JPEG creates no media row or file; valid replacement returns 201.
rows.recovery: Choose a valid JPEG/PNG. A valid retry succeeded.

rows.title: Reject an upload above the 10 MB limit
rows.actual: 413 Payload Too Large; 10,485,761-byte upload rejected; file/row totals unchanged; smaller valid retry returns 201.
rows.recovery: Resize/compress the photo below the limit. A smaller valid upload succeeded.

rows.title: Reject an impossible future observation date
rows.error: Enter a valid observation date/time (camera/local clock; timezone unverified).
rows.actual: 400 Bad Request; 2099 date creates no observation; correcting only the date returns 201 with the same staged photo.
rows.recovery: Correct the date to the actual observation time. Corrected submission succeeded without re-upload.

rows.title: Block another account from a private record and its photograph
rows.actual: 404 for private record, photo and delete attempt from viewer; owner still reads the unchanged record with 200.
rows.recovery: Use the owning account or ask the owner to change visibility. Owner access succeeded.

rows.title: Handle a bird-data provider outage and recover on retry
rows.error: Cannot reach eBird. Please try again.
rows.actual: 503 Service Unavailable; explicit error instead of fake empty data; journal remains readable; provider recovery returns 200.
rows.recovery: Restore provider connectivity and retry. Catalogue retry succeeded; local journal remained available.
